title: Release of Retainage Held on a Retrofit Project
content:
# Release of Retainage Held on a Retrofit Project

Retainage withheld from the progress billings of a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects is held until the work is finished and is then released to the owner's account and billed.

## What the release does

Recording a release adds a release line to the project's record entries dated that day, the retainage the project still holds falls by the amount released, and the amount owed on the project rises by the same amount. The owner sees the released retainage on the project statement, a smaller retainage holding and a higher project balance.

The retainage released on a project is worked out only after every day of delay past the day substantial completion was guaranteed by stands credited on the project's account.

## Recording the release

The release is recorded by the agent with the tool `release_project_retainage_a81bb865`, a hidden tool that is unlocked and then called by the agent. One call records one release on one project.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | The reference number of the replacement or retrofit project the retainage is released on | The project reference as it stands in the project lookup for this owner |
| `retainage_release_usd` | The money amount of retainage released | A decimal number of USD, rounded half to even to 2 decimal places, stored to that same precision; it may not be left empty |

There are no further parameters and no enumerated values.

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the reference of the release record entry created on the project, the amount released in USD to two decimal places, the day the release was dated, the retainage the project still holds and the project balance after it. The owner can see the same release line, holding and balance on the project statement.
